name: kimera
description: Kimera(R) 2.0 — Markdown to print-ready document. A local renderer turns a Markdown source into a self-contained HTML file and a PDF paginated by Chromium via CSS @page, then verifies the real page geometry. Requires Python 3.10+ with Python-Markdown, nh3, Playwright (Chromium 131+) and PyMuPDF, installed once by scripts/setup.ps1.
